task.title: Duplicate operation ULID crashes projection while validate calls the history valid
task.description: Found during PR #99's adversarial review; pre-existing on main (reproduced with an ordinary field.set on a main-built binary). A duplicated operation ULID within one task chain makes 'workbook validate --full' report VALID while every projection-touching command dies with a raw 'UNIQUE constraint failed: operations.operation_id (1555)' and 'rebuild' re-hits the same error — an unrecoverable state the validator vouches for. No Workbook build writes duplicate ULIDs, so the exposure is hand-edited or hostile refs, but the failure shape is wrong twice over: validate should refuse what the projection cannot hold, and the projection should refuse corrupt input with a category, not a raw SQLite error. Fix direction: history validation gains a duplicate-operation-ID check (corrupt-data), and the projection reports the constraint violation as corrupt-data naming the task instead of crashing.
